scenarios.purpose: A signed wrapper below the visible ChatGPT UI is observation-only.
An exact launchd-owned wrapper with one matching app-server starts a 600-second grace period.
Sleeping user work blocks automated cleanup regardless of CPU use.
A changed kernel birth identity resets the grace timer and prevents signalling.
Invalid lifecycle state fails closed and starts a new grace period.
A verified action records a redacted result without test writes to the host.
MCP-looking user arguments remain blockers unless they match an approved executable and argv shape.
A CPU-idle unrecognized node MCP under a detached tree lets the 600-second countdown run and the tree be reaped.
A soft blocker accruing at least 0.5 CPU-seconds per cycle, or one without a baseline yet, keeps the detached tree blocked.
MCP helper pid churn never resets idle_since because the generation keys on the stable wrapper/app-server identity.
A pre-v4 state file without soft-blocker baselines loads cleanly and fails closed for exactly one cycle.
